ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) patches at the distal regions of both lobes; approximate visible surface ratio of 75% dark to 25% light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-grey to black central region extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge. High-intensity white patches are localized at the distal tips. Left tip (viewer's perspective) contains a white field with dark mottling. Right tip contains a white field with distinct diagonal dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 60-70 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 2-5 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary; most pronounced on the inner edge of the right lobe and the outer tip of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the outer lateral margins sweeping upwards, transitioning to a complex, non-linear trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (scars) concentrated on the dark peduncle and central lower fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark diagonal linear streaks crossing the high-intensity white patch on the right distal lobe; vertical dark linear streaks present on the left distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive punctate white scarring on the peduncle; prominent irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe (viewer's perspective) near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled pigmentation pattern within the white distal patches, characterized by high-contrast dark spots and streaks against a white background.
